# SM Solar & Electrical (San Marina Engineering Limited)
# https://www.sanmarina.engineering

> San Marina Engineering Limited (San Marina, SM, SM Engineering, SM Solar, SM Solar & Electrical, San Marina Solar) is based in Kisumu, Kenya. We design, deliver and support solar PV, solar technology, solar solutions, battery energy storage, critical power, UPS, electrical infrastructure, electrical safety and compliance, solar water pumping, engineering consultancy and operations and maintenance for homes, businesses and institutions in Nairobi, Kisumu and towns across Kenya.

## Also known as
San Marina, San Marina Engineering, San Marina Engineering Limited, San Marina Solar, SM, SM Engineering, SM Solar, SM Solar Ltd, SM Solar Engineering, SM Solar & Electrical.
